description: WAHA bridge — outbound queue, admin pane, keyword DM, and a fail-closed HMAC webhook at POST /apollo/v1/wa/webhook. Boots on plugins_loaded:20 after apollo-core. Join queue is human-processed; the webhook never approves queue entries.

rest.description: WAHA inbound webhook — HMAC-SHA512 verified in permission_callback (fail closed)
rest.permission_summary: Transport, HMAC, timestamp window, session match, dedupe, and body-size checks before callback

$secret_policy: Secret option names are listed only. Values are never stored in the registry; apollo_wa_api_key and apollo_wa_hmac_key use autoload=false and admin UI shows mask() only.

security.note: Webhook is intentionally unauthenticated at the WP-user layer but gated by HMAC, timestamp, session, and dedupe checks. No secrets in registry.

$registry_gap_closed: On disk since branch cursor/registry-all-plugins-incl-waha; previously skipped in coordinator scans. Entry created 2026-09-15.
$version_note: Docblock and APOLLO_WAHA_VER constant read 0.1.0-pre; registry uses 0.1.0 to match doctor.js docblock regex.
